acceptance: A landing with an error-text test and no baseline row is refused at ship

repocontract.Packages() includes internal/testaudit, internal/gateregistry and internal/sysexec, so a ship runs their whole-tree guards (PR CI of #1597, #1598 and #1601 failed on these three after green local runs on 2026-11-20)
The ship backstop runs apicover-enforce on the changed packages (PR CI of #1597 and #1599 failed on apicover on 2026-11-20)
Recurrence 2026-11-21: console PRs #1623, #1634, #1646 and #1654 shipped error-text-match tests and #1652 a sleep-sync test; only CI caught them. evolve ship refuses each such change locally.
fix: Add ./internal/testaudit to repocontract.Packages so a landing runs TestTreeRatchet, as main CI does.
routed_reason: recurred 2026-11-21 across 5 console PRs; per the 2026-11-20 incident lesson the class fix goes to the first build of the next wave; ship is a protected surface
summary: repocontract.Packages() (go/internal/repocontract/repocontract.go:21) lists the whole-tree ratchets the ship gate runs; it holds rawgitratchet and sizeratchet but not internal/testaudit. The build floor now runs the scoped test-audit check (PR #1597); the ship backstop is the second line.
title: the ship backstop runs rawgit and size ratchets but not the test-audit ratchet
